resources.string: Starts when this device finishes syncing. Your entries are already encrypted. This also encrypts when you wrote each one and what kind it is, so only your devices can see any of it.
Encrypting and uploading %1$d of %2$d items. Your journal keeps syncing as usual.
Making sure nothing is missing before switching over.
Everything in your journal, including when you wrote each entry, is encrypted so only your devices can read it.
Downloading your journal and switching it back to standard encryption.
Your entries are encrypted, and your journal syncs the way it did before.
%1$s Nothing changed, and your journal keeps syncing.
When you wrote each entry and what kind it is will no longer be encrypted. Changes you made since switching come with you, and your other devices switch back the next time they sync.

plurals.name: journal_storage_problem_missing_here
plurals.item: %2$s: your account has %1$d this device doesn’t have yet. Sync this device, then try again.
%2$s: your account has %1$d this device doesn’t have yet. Sync this device, then try again.

plurals.name: journal_storage_problem_not_on_server
plurals.item: %2$s: %1$d on this device hasn’t been backed up yet. Let this device finish syncing, then try again.
%2$s: %1$d on this device haven’t been backed up yet. Let this device finish syncing, then try again.

plurals.name: journal_storage_problem_copy_differs
plurals.item: %2$s: the encrypted copy of %1$d didn’t match this device’s, even after uploading it again. Try again later.
%2$s: the encrypted copies of %1$d didn’t match this device’s, even after uploading them again. Try again later.

plurals.name: journal_storage_problem_media_unavailable
plurals.item: %1$d media file isn’t on this device or in your account. Sync the device that has it, then try again.
%1$d media files aren’t on this device or in your account. Sync the device that has them, then try again.

resources.string: %1$s: this device doesn’t sync these, so it can’t check them. Finish on a device that does.
Another of your devices is encrypting your journal. This device switches over when it’s done.
Your cloud storage is full. Free up space, then try again.
Enter your recovery phrase so this device can encrypt your journal.
Couldn’t connect. LogDate will try again automatically.
The change wasn’t accepted (%1$s). LogDate will try again automatically.
Switching back is no longer available.
Lets this device sync journals that are already fully encrypted.
Offers to encrypt your whole journal once this device has synced everything, if your server supports it. Also turns on syncing fully encrypted journals.
